chapters.title: Looking back from Horeb
chapters.summary: On the plains of Moab, Moses begins his farewell speeches. He recalls leaving Horeb, appointing judges, and the day Israel refused to enter the land out of fear.

chapters.title: Journey past Edom and Moab
chapters.summary: Moses recalls how God led Israel peacefully past Edom, Moab and Ammon, and then gave them victory over Sihon king of Heshbon.

chapters.title: Victory over Og
chapters.summary: Israel defeats Og king of Bashan and the land east of the Jordan is given to Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh. Moses is allowed to see the land but not enter it.

chapters.title: Do not forget
chapters.summary: Moses urges Israel to keep God's laws and never forget what they saw at Horeb. They must not make idols, for God is a consuming fire, yet a merciful God who will not forsake them.

chapters.title: The Ten Commandments again
chapters.summary: Moses repeats the Ten Commandments given at Horeb and reminds Israel that they asked him to stand between them and God.

chapters.title: Hear, O Israel
chapters.summary: The Shema: the Lord our God is one Lord; love Him with all your heart, soul and might. Teach these words to your children and do not forget the Lord when you prosper.

chapters.title: A people holy to the Lord
chapters.summary: Israel must not make treaties with the nations of Canaan or adopt their gods. God chose them not because they were many, but because He loved them and keeps His oath.

chapters.title: Man does not live by bread alone
chapters.summary: God humbled Israel in the wilderness and fed them with manna to teach them that people live by every word from God. In plenty, they must remember who gives them power to prosper.

chapters.title: Not because of your righteousness
chapters.summary: Israel will take the land because of the nations' wickedness and God's promise, not their own goodness. Moses recalls the golden calf and how he prayed for them.

chapters.title: What does the Lord require?
chapters.summary: God gives new tablets and sets the Levites apart. He asks Israel to fear Him, walk in His ways, love Him and serve Him, and to love the stranger.

chapters.title: Blessing and curse
chapters.summary: Moses describes the good land God watches over and sets before Israel a choice: blessing for obedience and a curse for turning to other gods.

chapters.title: One place of worship
chapters.summary: Israel must destroy the Canaanite shrines and bring their offerings only to the place God will choose, where they will rejoice before Him.

chapters.title: False prophets
chapters.summary: Anyone who urges Israel to follow other gods, even a prophet with signs, a relative or a whole town, must not be heeded.

chapters.title: Clean food and the tithe
chapters.summary: Laws on clean and unclean food, and the yearly tithe eaten with joy before the Lord, with every third year's tithe shared with the Levite, stranger, orphan and widow.

chapters.title: The year of release
chapters.summary: Every seven years debts are cancelled and Hebrew servants go free with generous gifts. Open your hand to the poor among you.

chapters.title: Three feasts and justice
chapters.summary: Israel must keep Passover, the Feast of Weeks and the Feast of Tabernacles, and appoint judges who judge fairly: justice, and only justice, you shall pursue.

chapters.title: Courts and kings
chapters.summary: Hard cases go to the priests and judge. A future king must not multiply horses, wives or wealth, and must read God's law all his life.

chapters.title: A prophet like Moses
chapters.summary: The priests and Levites live from the offerings. Israel must avoid divination, and God promises to raise up a prophet like Moses to speak His words.

chapters.title: Cities of refuge
chapters.summary: Cities of refuge protect someone who kills by accident. Boundary stones must not be moved, and false witnesses are punished.

chapters.title: Rules for war
chapters.summary: Do not be afraid in battle, for God goes with you. The fearful may go home, peace must be offered first, and fruit trees must not be cut down.

chapters.title: Various laws
chapters.summary: Laws for unsolved murders, captive women, the rights of a firstborn son and a rebellious son, and the burial of an executed body.

chapters.title: Care for your neighbor
chapters.summary: Return a neighbor's lost animal, put a railing on your roof, and keep laws on mixing and on sexual conduct and marriage.

chapters.title: The assembly and the camp
chapters.summary: Who may enter the assembly of the Lord, keeping the camp clean, shelter for escaped slaves, and keeping vows promptly.

chapters.title: Divorce and fairness
chapters.summary: Laws on divorce, a newly married man's year at home, fair wages paid daily, and leaving gleanings for the stranger, orphan and widow.

chapters.title: Fair punishment and weights
chapters.summary: Limits on punishment, kindness to the ox treading grain, levirate marriage, honest weights and measures, and remembering Amalek.

chapters.title: Firstfruits
chapters.summary: In the land, Israel brings firstfruits and recites how God brought a wandering Aramean's family out of Egypt. The covenant is affirmed: you are His people.

chapters.title: The law written on stones
chapters.summary: After crossing the Jordan, Israel is to write the law on plastered stones at Mount Ebal. The Levites call out curses and all the people answer, Amen.

chapters.title: Blessings and curses
chapters.summary: Moses lists the blessings that will follow obedience and the long, grim curses that will fall on disobedience, ending in exile among the nations.

chapters.title: The covenant in Moab
chapters.summary: Moses renews the covenant with everyone present and with future generations. The secret things belong to God, but what is revealed belongs to us.

chapters.title: Choose life
chapters.summary: If Israel returns to God, He will restore them and circumcise their hearts. God's word is very near, and Moses calls them to choose life and love the Lord.

chapters.title: Be strong and courageous
chapters.summary: Moses hands leadership to Joshua and gives the written law to the priests to be read every seventh year. God tells Moses that Israel will turn away.

chapters.title: The song of Moses
chapters.summary: Moses teaches Israel a song about God the Rock, His faithfulness, Israel's rebellion and His final mercy. God tells Moses to climb Mount Nebo.

chapters.title: Moses blesses the tribes
chapters.summary: Moses blesses each tribe in turn. The eternal God is your refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms.

chapters.title: The death of Moses
chapters.summary: Moses sees the whole land from Mount Nebo and dies there. Joshua is filled with wisdom to lead, and no prophet arose like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face.
